conviction_note: Nothing to trade here. Addex's H1 numbers are mechanical: operating burn is about CHF 0.5M a quarter and the August ATM already reset the runway. The only thing in the release that could move the stock is an update on Neurosterix's NTX-253 Phase 1, and its direction cannot be read ahead of time. The small positive tilt in my draft rested on two months of silence, which counts as absence of evidence and is worth 0. The company's two confirmed results releases this year moved the stock -0.57% and -1.0%.
bar: No bar exists. I found no consensus EPS or revenue from any source. RTTNews (https://www.rttnews.com/3693730/can-addex-therapeutics-maintain-its-cost-cutting-momentum-in-q2.aspx) only restates Q1 (net loss CHF 1.712M, operating loss CHF 0.48M, cash CHF 0.935M). The company gives no guidance beyond 'runway into Q4 2027' (https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/08/26/3351077/0/en/addex-raises-usd-2-8-million-through-its-atm-agreement-and-extends-cash-runway-to-the-fourth-quarter-2027.html). Any size on this name is capped small.
positioning_check: The sweep row carries two conflicting numbers: 4,133 ADSs short and 1.0 days to cover (FINRA settlement 2026-08-31, nasdaq.com snippet), against 5.61% of float and 1.9 days (fintel snippet, undated). I could not reach the Nasdaq short-interest API myself (HTTP 503 on 2026-09-25). No options market exists, so there is no skew. The tape is thin: 20-day average volume is about 35k ADSs, with 3k to 13k a day this week. The stock is up 7.65% over five days, most of it +5.78% on 2026-09-25 on the Indivior rights return. On 2026-08-21 it spiked intraday to about $14.75 and closed at $4.57 (https://stockstotrade.com/news/addex-therapeutics-ltd-adxn-news-2026_08_21/). That is a retail momentum tape, not a positioned one. No negative finding was made, so the short check did not gate anything.

findings.finding: Neurosterix (Addex holds 20%) guided completion of the NTX-253 M4 PAM Phase 1 for July 2026 in Addex's Q1 release of 2026-06-25. There has been no completion or data announcement since, and ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07344948 still reads RECRUITING with a May 2026 primary completion date, last updated 2026-01-15. The 2026-09-28 call has the Head of Translational Science on the program, so the H1 release is the natural place for that update, but its direction cannot be read ahead of time.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No direct precedent in the baseline. Pipeline news has moved this name more than results releases have: +3.86% on 2026-04-29 (chronic-cough data) and +5.78% on 2026-09-25 (Indivior rights return), against -0.57% on the FY release of 2026-04-30 and -1.0% on the Q1 release of 2026-06-25. The 2026-08-21 intraday spike on vague 'clinical progress' talk shows the retail tape will chase pipeline language.
findings.why_not_priced: The Phase 1 outcome is not public, so it cannot be priced in either direction. If the market expected a readout, the thin tape into the release would show volume building and a larger move than the +5.78% Indivior day; this week traded 3k to 13k ADSs a day. There is no directional edge, so the size is 0 and the band carries the risk.
findings.independence: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07344948 (https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies?query.term=NTX-253) shows the registry was not updated after January. That confirms the timing gap, not a direction. The April 2026 'on track for Q2' release (https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/04/23/3279552/0/en/Addex-Spin-Out-Company-Neurosterix-on-Track-to-Complete-Phase-1-Clinical-Study-of-NTX-253-for-Schizophrenia-in-Q2-2026.html) shows the timeline has already slipped once, from Q2 to July.

searched_and_found_nothing: Indivior returned the GABAB PAM rights (https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/09/25/3368838/0/en/addex-regains-rights-to-gabab-positive-allosteric-modulator-portfolio-from-indivior.html, 2026-09-25). It is already public, the stock rose 5.78% on it the same day, and no financial terms were disclosed. That is the 09-25 6-K the baseline mistook for a print, and it is priced.
Supernus-Indivior merger (https://ir.supernus.com/news-releases/news-release-details/supernus-pharmaceuticals-and-indivior-pharmaceuticals-merge) has no read-through beyond the rights return.

The Form 4 cluster of 2026-09-04 (eight filings, e.g. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1574232/000110465926105509/tm2624769-5_4seq1.xml) is an option repricing to $0.032 per share by the Remuneration Committee. No open-market buying or selling.

ATM and ADS count: 437,869 ADSs sold for $2.8M (about $6.39 per ADS, into the August 21 spike), 210.3M shares outstanding afterwards, runway into Q4 2027. All in the wire. The H1 balance sheet will show very low June 30 cash (Q1 was CHF 0.935M, burn about CHF 0.5M a quarter before the equity-method Neurosterix loss), but the August raise was already disclosed.
Addex press-release page, checked 2026-09-25: no releases other than those above since June.
Neurosterix news, financing or Series B: nothing public in 2026 beyond the Addex-issued timeline releases.
Consensus or estimate sources: none found.
baseline_tension: There is no skew, and the reaction history is untrustworthy (6-K artefacts). Rebuilt from the two confirmed results releases, the base rate is about 1% in absolute terms. The +7.65% five-day run-up is the priced Indivior news. My one finding has no sign, so the baseline is not contradicted and the price carries everything I could source.
lessons_applied: Lesson 5 ('an absence of explanation is worth 0'): the draft's +0.5 on the Neurosterix item rested on two months of silence after the guided July completion, which is inference from absence. I re-sized it to 0 and kept the -8/+10 band.
Lesson 6 (bar unsourced, cap every size small): no consensus exists and print_vs_bar stays null. This confirms the small size and does not move it further.
'A reaction history built from the wrong events': I rebuilt the base rate from the two confirmed results releases (2026-04-30 -0.57%, 2026-06-25 -1.0%) rather than the baseline's 4.43% median.
Lesson 8 (thin coverage) was considered and left alone: I hold no confirmed unpriced number, so it does not apply.
